# Sonexial

> Sonexial engineers websites, entity graphs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) infrastructure for businesses, professional practices, and authors so AI search systems and human buyers can find, verify, and quote their work.

DIY website builders give you visual templates. Traditional agencies optimize only for legacy blue-link keywords. Sonexial builds machine-readable entity clarity, semantic HTML hierarchy, JSON-LD knowledge graphs, and crawler readiness from day one.

This llms.txt overview is optional and designed for humans and automated retrieval tools that choose to read it. It is not required for inclusion in Google AI features or ChatGPT search and does not guarantee AI citations.

- [Pricing & Packages](https://sonexial.com/kits) - Self-serve diagnostics, 72-hour GEO implementation sprints, and full custom website builds for SMBs and authors.

## Core Services & Products

- **Free AI Visibility Scan ($0):** Instant heuristic assessment of observable technical-readiness signals on publicly accessible SMB and author websites.
- **GEO Diagnostic ($297):** Automated 30-page site crawl (~35 technical checks per page) ranked in an Impact vs. Effort matrix, complete with ready-to-paste JSON-LD (`Organization`, `LocalBusiness`, `ProfessionalService`, `Service`, `FAQPage`, or `Person`/`Book`), `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, and a 30-day action plan.
- **72-Hour GEO Implementation Sprint ($750 SMB / $497 Author):** Done-for-you engineering and installation of entity schema, `FAQPage` structured data, AI search crawler rules, and semantic fixes on your existing website.
- **Starter & Platform Website Builds ($497–$3,000):** Done-for-you, fast, mobile-first websites engineered with complete GEO entity architecture.
- **Monthly GEO Retainer ($300/mo):** Ongoing technical readiness audits and sampled observations of public AI search answers.
- **Amazon Visibility Kit ($99):** One-time kit for authors covering BISAC categories, 7 backend keywords, and KDP HTML description.

## Founder & Credentials

Sonexial was founded by Brian Plescher, an author, operations leader, and strategist based in Grand Haven, Michigan (MS in Management, Strategy & Leadership from Michigan State University; Executive Education in Accelerated Management from Yale School of Management).
